answer.text: The UN should use existing reporting under the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change to track implementation of the Glasgow Climate Pact, including the fulfilment of commitments on climate finance and technology transfer.
answer.reason: India supports an inclusive process in which all developing countries participate. A separate annual report to the Security Council would frame climate change as a distinct security issue and divert attention from agreed commitments.

answer.text: The Security Council requests the Secretary-General to include in reports on matters on its agenda, where relevant, an assessment of how climate change affects international peace and security in the region or thematic context under consideration.
answer.reason: France supports Council consideration of climate-related threats. Reporting on specific agenda items would help the Council assess the risks and decide what response each situation warrants.
